description: The Council on Strategic Risks (CSR) is a nonprofit, non-partisan security policy institute devoted to anticipating, analyzing and addressing core systemic risks to security in the 21st century, with special examination of the ways in which these risks intersect and exacerbate one another. The CSR runs the International Mid-Career Biosecurity Fellowship and the Mid-Career Biodefense Bootcamp Fellowship. The Janne E. Nolan Center on Strategic Weapons (The Nolan Center) is a non-partisan institute of CSR that explores threat reduction opportunities related to the development, diffusion and use of strategic weapons in a challenging security landscape.

label: Novavax
intervention_focuses: Vaccines
description: Novavax is an American biotechnology company that develops vaccines to counter serious infectious diseases. They are currently working on vaccines for COVID-19, influenza, and malaria.

label: Nuclear Threat Initiative | bio (NTI.bio)
intervention_focuses: Biological weapons ; Dual-use research of concern
description: NTI Global Biological Policy and Programs (NTI | bio) works to build international capacity to prevent catastrophic biological events. We advance this work by strengthening biotechnology governance and biosecurity internationally; bolstering international capabilities to prevent bioweapons development and use by states; driving progress in advancing global health security capacity; and developing the next generation of biosecurity experts.

label: Observatorio de Riesgos Catastróficos Globales (ORCG)
intervention_focuses: AI x Bio ; Pathogen surveillance ; Digital detection ; Crisis management ; Supply chain disruption
location_hints: North America (excl. US) ; Mexico ; South America ; Colombia ; Europe (excl. UK) ; Spain ; Madrid ; Remote
description: ORCG is a scientific diplomacy organization that works to improve the management of global risks in Spanish-speaking countries. To achieve our mission, they connect decision makers with experts and develop evidence-based publications.

label: OpenAeros
intervention_focuses: Personal protective equipment ; Indoor air quality
description: OpenAeros aims to develop open source and low-cost tools to ensure that life-saving respiratory health measures are working as effectively as possible.

label: Oxford Biosecurity Group (OBG)
description: Oxford Biosecurity Group (OBG) is a team of researchers dedicated to addressing issues related to biosecurity. OBG runs multiple 8-week, remote-first projects, and we partner with relevant organisations in the space to drive progress on pressing issues and to help individuals test their fit, grow their network, and upskill in biosecurity. Researchers work in small teams, led by a project lead, to conduct impactful research culminating in one or more final deliverables. A key way that these projects lead to real-world impact is through partnerships - outputs are shared with key stakeholders, and many projects are run in collaboration with an existing organisation.

label: Pasteur Institute
intervention_focuses: Antimicrobial resistance ; Epidemiology ; Therapeutics ; Vaccines ; Rapid diagnostics ; Pathogen surveillance ; Digital detection ; Biological weapons ; DNA synthesis
description: The Pasteur Institute is an international research and education institute that is committed to advancing science, medicine and public health. It has been responsible for multiple historical discoveries that have helped control infectious diseases.

label: Peace Research Institute Frankfurt (PRIF) • Biological and Chemical Disarmament and Security Research Group
intervention_focuses: Dual-use research of concern ; Biological weapons ; Lab biosafety
description: The PRIF analyzes the causes of international and intrastate conflicts and look for ways to resolve them. The research group analyzes the prohibitions of chemical and biological weapons in an interdisciplinary approach that includes perspectives from political science, international law and the natural sciences.

label: Pfizer
intervention_focuses: Vaccines ; Therapeutics ; Antimicrobial resistance
location_hints: Global ; Europe (excl. UK) ; North America (excl. US) ; South America ; North Africa ; Middle East ; East Asia & Pacific ; Central Asia ; South Asia ; United Kingdom ; USA
description: Pfizer is an American multinational pharmaceutical and biotechnology corporation. Alongside BioNTech, they are responsible for the Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 mRNA vaccine.

label: Pivotal Research
intervention_focuses: AI x Bio ; Dual-use research of concern
description: Pivotal (ex Swiss Existential Risk Initiative / CHERI) is committed to understanding and reducing global catastrophic risks, especially those arising from advanced artificial intelligence and biotechnology. By supporting exceptional talent poised to make significant contributions to reducing these risks, they set the stage for important research and policy work. In doing so, they aim for a brighter and safer world for everyone.

label: Podcast - Hear This Idea
description: Good ideas for big problems. Hear This Idea is a podcast about ideas for solving important problems, and the people trying to figure them out.

label: Podcast - The 80,000 Hours Podcast
description: In-depth conversations about the world’s most pressing problems and what you can do to solve them. They have several episodes tagged "Catastrophic Pandemics” or "Biorisk strategy & policy”.

label: PopVax
intervention_focuses: Vaccines
description: PopVax is an Indian biotechnology company based in Hyderabad building a novel thermostable, low-cost, and safe second-generation mRNA platform for rationally-designed broadly-protective multi-epitope vaccines.

label: Pour Demain
intervention_focuses: DNA synthesis ; Indoor air quality ; Pathogen surveillance
location_hints: Europe (excl. UK) ; Switzerland ; Bern ; Berlin ; Germany ; Brussels ; Belgium
description: Pour Demain is a non-profit think tank, developing proposals on neglected issues. They are committed to evidence-based policies, developing scientifically sound recommendations and facilitating the exchange between science, politics and civil society.

label: RAND
intervention_focuses: Biological weapons ; Crisis management ; Epidemiology
location_hints: Global ; USA ; Europe (excl. UK) ; United Kingdom ; Belgium ; Australia ; Netherlands ; Santa Monica CA ; Pittsburgh PA ; Boston MA ; Cambridge ; Brussels ; Canberra ; Rotterdam
description: RAND is a research organization that develops solutions to public policy challenges to help make communities throughout the world safer and more secure, healthier and more prosperous. It brings together expertise in public health systems, biosecurity and biotechnology, pandemic response and health to develop and evaluate strategies, test novel solutions in health surveillance and strengthen the future public health system.

label: Resilience Action Network International (rani)
intervention_focuses: Crisis management ; Vaccines ; Supply chain disruption ; Pathogen surveillance
description: Rani (formerly the Pandemic Action Network) is a global advocacy network of over 400 global multi-sector organizations. They aim to forsee emerging threats and make societies better prepared to tackle health, climate, and economic shifts. This include humanity being better prepared to deal with outbreaks and prevent a deadly and costly pandemic from happening again.

label: Robert Koch Institute (RKI)
intervention_focuses: Pathogen surveillance ; Antimicrobial resistance ; Biological weapons ; Rapid diagnostics ; Crisis management
description: RKI is Germany’s public health institute. They investigate disease and health on all levels: from viruses in human cells to obesity in the population. RKI scientists collect data on non-communicable diseases, on infectious diseases and (new) biological dangers. On this basis, they develop policy recommendations and preventive strategies.

label: Roche
intervention_focuses: Therapeutics ; Rapid diagnostics ; Antimicrobial resistance
location_hints: Global ; Europe (excl. UK) ; North America (excl. US) ; South America ; North Africa ; Sub-Saharan Africa ; Middle East ; East Asia & Pacific ; Central Asia ; South Asia ; United Kingdom ; USA
description: Roche is a Swiss multinational healthcare company. One of their focus areas is on Infectious Diseases.

label: Rosetta Commons Biosecurity Fellowship
intervention_focuses: AI x Bio
description: The Rosetta Commons Biosecurity Fellowship is a 12-month remote role at the intersection of computational biology and biosecurity. Fellows will engage with researchers and explore how AI-enabled protein design tools can be developed and governed responsibly.

label: RTX BBN Technologies
intervention_focuses: Synthetic biology ; DNA synthesis ; Rapid diagnostics
description: RTX BBN Technologies, a subsidiary of RTX Corporation, specializes in research and development across domains such as quantum engineering, artificial intelligence, and cybersecurity. BBN has notably contributed to advancements like the ARPANET and quantum cryptography. They are now partly focused on synthetic biology, including DNA synthesis security screening.

label: Sabeti Lab
intervention_focuses: Pathogen surveillance ; Rapid diagnostics ; Therapeutics ; Epidemiology
description: This lab, led by Dr. Pardis Sabeti at the Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard, is a team of scientists, mathematicians, public health professionals, and educators working to stop the next infectious disease outbreak before it starts. They are developing new ways to track outbreaks, diagnose diseases, and uncover fundamental biology.

label: Sandia National Laboratories (SNL)
activities: Research ; Education & Career ; Policy development ; Technology development
intervention_focuses: Dual-use research of concern ; Biological weapons ; Lab biosafety ; Pathogen surveillance ; Rapid diagnostics ; Therapeutics ; Antimicrobial resistance
description: Sandia National Laboratories, established in 1949, is a U.S. research institution dedicated to national security, which includes a research area on biodefense. In addition, its Global Chemical and Biological Security (GCBS) program focuses on reducing chemical and biological threats worldwide by promoting the responsible use of related materials, strengthening security capacities, and improving risk mitigation strategies.

label: Sculpting Evolution Group (Esvelt Lab) @ MIT Media Lab
intervention_focuses: DNA synthesis ; Pathogen surveillance ; Therapeutics
description: We are committed biotechnologists who: • Catalyze beneficial advances by applying robotics and machine learning to evolve new molecular tools and techniques • Apply molecules, models, and cryptography to defend against pandemics and prevent the catastrophic misuse of biotechnology • Work with the guidance of interested communities to safely and humanely edit wild populations and ecosystems.

label: SecureBio
intervention_focuses: Pathogen surveillance ; Indoor air quality ; Dual-use research of concern ; AI x Bio
description: SecureBio's in-house team of researchers and technologists work with experts in academia, industry and government to develop new technologies and policy proposals to delay, detect, and defend against any catastrophic pandemic, whether natural or engineered.

label: SecureBio Detection
intervention_focuses: Pathogen surveillance ; Dual-use research of concern
description: SecureBio Detection (formerly the Nucleic Acid Observatory), as part of SecureBio, aims to design new disease surveillance methods capable of detecting any pandemic threat. They are particularly focused on pathogens that – whether through natural evolution or deliberate engineering – may evade existing or near-future surveillance systems focused on known pathogens of concern.

label: SecureDNA
intervention_focuses: DNA synthesis
description: SecureDNA is a free, non-profit screening platform designed to safeguard DNA synthesis everywhere. SecureDNA allows synthesis companies to verifiably screen all DNA synthesis and makes it virtually impossible for hazardous DNA to be obtained without authorization.

label: Sentinel
intervention_focuses: Crisis management
description: Sentinel is a foresight team and emergency response team seeking to anticipate & react to large-scale catastrophes, particularly those of a speculative nature.

label: Sentinel Bio
intervention_focuses: Pathogen surveillance ; AI x Bio ; DNA synthesis ; Synthetic biology ; Indoor air quality ; Personal protective equipment
description: Sentinel Bio finds, funds, and scales solutions to prevent biosecurity risks and respond to pandemics, across three areas: • Understanding the drivers of catastrophic pandemics • Strengthening safeguards on advanced biotechnologies • Bolstering global pandemic preparedness.

label: Stanford Existential Risk Initiative (SERI)
description: Working to preserve the future of humanity. Existential risks, or global catastrophic risks, are risks that could cause the collapse of human civilization.

label: Stockholm International Peace Research Institute (SIPRI)
intervention_focuses: Biological weapons ; Dual-use research of concern
description: SIPRI is an independent international institute dedicated to research into conflict, armaments, arms control and disarmament. Established in 1966, SIPRI provides data, analysis and recommendations, based on open sources, to policymakers, researchers, media and the interested public. Some of its activities are focused on chemical and biological weapons.

label: Survival & Flourishing Fund
description: [from https://survivalandflourishing.com/] Survival and Flourishing .Com (“SFC”) is a Public Benefit Corporation engaged in philanthropy to support companies, organizations, and projects with positive externalities for the survival and flourishing of humanity and other sentient beings. We distribute non-dilutive grants to for-profit companies recommended by grant recommendation processes ogranized through survivalandflourishing.fund (“SFF”), and we also engage directly in specific philanthropic projects, such as OpenLetter.net, a project of SFC. Currently our work is financed by philanthropist Jaan Tallinn.

label: Texas A&M Scowcroft Institute
activities: Research ; Policy development ; Outreach & Advocacy ; Funding
intervention_focuses: Crisis management ; Biological weapons ; Pathogen surveillance
description: The Scowcroft Institute of International Affairs is a policy-oriented research institute and think tank at Texas A&M University. Its Biosecurity and Pandemic Policy Program is dedicated to promoting a world safe, secure, and resilient against existential biological threats.

label: The Pandemic Center
activities: Policy development ; Research ; Outreach & Advocacy ; Education & Career
intervention_focuses: Pathogen surveillance ; Indoor air quality ; Vaccines ; Epidemiology ; Crisis management
description: The Pandemic Center at the Brown University School of Public Health works to reduce vulnerabilities and increase resilience to pandemics, other biological emergencies, and the harms they pose to health, peace, security, and prosperity. They run the Biosecurity Game changers fellowship.

label: The Unjournal
description: The Unjournal is making research better by evaluating what really matters. It aims to make rigorous research more impactful and impactful research more rigorous. They provide a database of prioritized research with potential for impact.

label: The WHO Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence (WHO Pandemic Hub)
intervention_focuses: Pathogen surveillance ; Antimicrobial resistance ; Crisis management
description: This WHO Hub’s mission is to improve data, analytics and decision-making to minimize the impacts of pandemic and epidemic threats. It supports countries to strengthen their capacity to detect, monitor and manage current and future public health threats.

label: United Nations Institute for Disarmament Research (UNIDIR)
activities: Research ; Policy development ; Outreach & Advocacy ; Education & Career
intervention_focuses: Biological weapons
description: The UNIDIR is an autonomous institution within the United Nations that conducts independent research on pressing global challenges related to disarmament, arms control and international security. They also run the BWC Advanced Education Course.

label: United Nations Office for Disarmament Affairs (UNODA)
intervention_focuses: Biological weapons
location_hints: Geneva ; Switzerland ; Europe (excl. UK) ; Vienna ; New York City ; USA ; Global
description: The Office for Disarmament Affairs supports multilateral efforts aimed at achieving the ultimate goal of general and complete disarmament under strict and effective international control. Weapons of mass destruction, in particular nuclear weapons, continue to be of primary concern owing to their destructive power and the threat that they pose to humanity. They also run the Youth for Biosecurity Fellowship.

label: United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNDRR)
intervention_focuses: Crisis management
description: The UNDRR convenes partners and coordinates activities to create safer, more resilient communities.

label: United States Office of Pandemic Preparedness and Response Policy (OPPR) [INACTIVE]
intervention_focuses: Crisis management ; Pathogen surveillance ; Vaccines ; Therapeutics ; Rapid diagnostics ; Personal protective equipment ; Supply chain disruption
description: The Office of Pandemic Preparedness and Response Policy (OPPR) within the Executive Office of the President leads and coordinates actions related to preparedness for, and response to, known and unknown biological threats and pathogens that could lead to a pandemic or to significant public health-related disruptions in the United States.

label: Vir Biotechnology
intervention_focuses: Therapeutics ; Vaccines
description: Vir Biotechnology is a clinical-stage immunology company focused on combining immunologic insights with technologies to treat and prevent serious infectious diseases. Their current programs include work on HIV, influenza, and HBV.

label: Wellcome Sanger Institute
intervention_focuses: Pathogen surveillance ; Epidemiology ; Rapid diagnostics ; Synthetic biology
description: The Wellcome Sanger Institute is a non-profit British genomics and genetics research institute. They have a Parasites and Microbes Programme, a Generative and Synthetic Genomics Programme and a Genomic Surveillance Unit.

label: Wyss Institute @ Harvard University
intervention_focuses: Vaccines ; Therapeutics ; Rapid diagnostics ; Indoor air quality ; Synthetic biology ; Antimicrobial resistance
description: Harvard-affiliated bioengineering institute developing biologically inspired technologies, including rapid diagnostics, organ-on-chip platforms and pathogen-detection tools relevant to pandemic preparedness.
